caption:
Comment "ROAST" and I'll DM you the free 5-Critic Ad Roast 📩

Bunty let Meta turn one kurta photo into a video ad and was about to put ₹5,000 on it (example number). Before he spent a rupee, I dropped its first frame into the 5-Critic Ad Roast in Claude. Five critics flagged a floating kurta with nobody in it, a missing price, no reason to buy before Diwali, and an opening that looks like every other ad. Then his mummy's 2-second phone clip beat the AI video.

The catch: Meta's image-to-video is open to all advertisers, but what it makes varies a lot from photo to photo. The critics are AI opinions, not your buyers, so test the version you pick on a small budget first.

Follow so the DM lands.

The prompt is free. You need Claude (the free plan works), a screenshot of your ad's first frame or a short description of it, and your headline and caption.
